review_candidates.title: System Architect - IaaS Compute & Storage
review_candidates.description: KBC Group provides banking services in 5 European countries. The international IT solutions of the banking group, covering several European countries , takes place with Hungarian and Belgian colleagues in Hungary and Belgium , therefore not only our services are international , but also our teams . Our responsibilities range from day-to-day operation to application development and its operation. We are constantly expanding the Hungarian side of the team , which is why we are looking for enthusiastic, motivated new team members with junior, medior or possibly senior work experience. As System Architect for IaaS Compute & Storage within Group Data Centers (GDC), you define and guard the end to end architecture of KBC’s on premise infrastructure platforms. You translate strategic direction, risk constraints and operational needs into clear architectural choices for compute and storage services that underpin critical banking workloads. You work at the intersection of engineering, product management and governance. Beyond designing target architectures, you ensure they are buildable, operable and compliant, guiding teams through lifecycle changes, platform evolution, and large transformation programs (e.g. datacenter renewal, resilience improvements, automation). You are a trusted technical authority who brings clarity, makes tradeoffs explicit and keeps the long term architecture coherent. What you can expect working with us: You can make sure your future career is steady within our company Life-long learning and plenty of opportunities to challenge yourself Competitive salary as well as other benefits such as: 10% customizable cafeteria, annual performance-based reward, company phone with mobile internet, that you can use for private purposes as well employee discount at the bank Medicare Your English language skills won’t be worn out as you can use it on a daily basis Flexible schedule as we don’t use ‘Clock in Clock out’ system As our focus is on teamwork we consider it important to hang out in the "open office" together, but you have the option to spend 3 days per week working from home We value your insight and are always open to suggestions International environment with a cheerful work atmosphere Green office in Millennium Park, equipped with: bicycle storage and showers restaurant with panoramic views over the Danube and the National Theatre free coffee in our community area where we hang out and play darts, and many dining options in the surrounding area Your responsibilities: Own the system architecture for IaaS compute and storage platforms (e.g. virtualization, cluster design, SAN/NAS, DRP constructs, zoning and segregation). Define and maintain as is and to be architectures, including architectural principles, guardrails and standards aligned with KBC Enterprise Architecture and Assurance expectations. Create and evolve the architectural runway: enable upcoming platform capabilities while managing technical debt and lifecycle constraints. Guide and challenge solution designs proposed by teams, vendors and integrators; ensure consistency across datacenters and environments. Lead architectural decisions around availability, resilience, performance, scalability, recoverability and security, balancing cost and risk. Act as architectural counterpart in major initiatives (e.g. NewDC, DRP redesign, storage evolution, hypervisor lifecycle, automation initiatives). Bring architectural topics to the appropriate architecture boards and governance forums; clearly document decisions and rationale. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, SDO, Risk and Security to ensure architectures are operationally sound and auditable. Mentor engineers by explaining architectural intent and promoting systems thinking across the teams. What we expect from you: Strong experience as a System or Infrastructure Architect in complex enterprise environments. Deep understanding of IaaS x86 compute and storage technologies (virtualization platforms, SAN/NAS concepts, DRP patterns, capacity and performance design). Experience with integration towards supporting services (telecom, Service Now, PaaS platforms, etc.) Proven ability to design architectures that are resilient, secure and operable in regulated environments. Comfortable working in a SAFe / agile context, translating strategy into enabler epics and architectural guidance. Able to reason at multiple levels: from conceptual models to concrete technical implications. Strong communication skills: you can explain architectural choices to both technical and non technical stakeholders. Fluent in English What you can expect during the recruitment process: After sending your CV in English, expect a three-round interview process, one online with our local recruiter, one online in English with the Belgian team leader, and the final round is in person at our office in Budapest (in Hungarian) to get to know each other better. An efficient selection process is important for both of us, so we try to make it as fast as possible, and even if you are not selected we will give you a detailed feedback.

review_candidates.description: En ABB , ayudamos a las industrias a funcionar de forma más eficiente y limpia, y cada una de las personas que trabajan aquí lo hace posible. Estarás capacitado para liderar, apoyado para crecer y orgulloso del impacto que creamos juntos. Únete a nosotros y ayuda a que funcione lo que hace funcionar el mundo. Este Puesto Reporta a International Sales Manager - MONM __ Your Role And Responsibilities The Regional Sales Manager is a regional business owner - not a traditional sales leader - who reports directly to the EVP International Sales as part of the core international leadership team. The Regional Sales Manager has full end-to-end accountability for all commercial activities in their assigned geography, including strategy, customer development, quotation, orders, delivery, invoicing, and cash collection. Operating with entrepreneurial autonomy, the RSM holds the regional P&L, leads a distributed team of country managers and sales professionals, commercializes the portfolios of three Global Business Lines across their region, and coordinates with Global Operations for supply chain support. Beyond day-to-day sales execution, the RSM serves as ABB Motion's strategic eyes and ears in the market, actively identifying growth opportunities, market gaps, competitive dynamics, product adaptation needs, and acquisition targets - providing structured, actionable market intelligence that directly informs global product strategy and organizational decisions, rather than simply managing existing business. The work model for the role is: hybrid ; The role is contributing to the Motion / NEMA Motors Division globally. You Will Be Mainly Accountable For Regional Business Strategy & Market Development – Define and execute go-to-market models, develop 3-year regional strategies, drive profitable growth, identify whitespace opportunities, and expand market share across new and existing customer segments in the assigned region. Sales Performance & P&L Accountability – Own the regional P&L including orders, revenue, gross margin, and profitability; drive order and margin targets; manage costs, EBITA profit, and working capital; and maintain financial discipline across all commercial metrics. Customer Relationship & Account Management – Build and maintain senior-level customer relationships; provide trusted advisory services to key accounts; manage channel partners and account coordination; and drive best-in-class customer experience across the region. Market Intelligence & Portfolio Feedback – Gather market insights on competitive landscape, pricing dynamics, and application trends; provide structured feedback to product leadership on portfolio gaps, certifications, and product adaptation needs; and identify acquisition targets or partnership opportunities. LSU Partnership & Sales Team Leadership – Lead and inspire Area Sales Managers and sales professionals; develop comprehensive sales plans with local sales units aligned to regional goals; drive quarterly business reviews; and create a high-performance team culture with strong accountability and continuous improvement. Sales Planning & Performance Management – Develop and drive regional sales plans with clear objectives and action plans; analyze channel and segment results; monitor KPIs and trends; identify deviations; and implement corrective actions to meet budget expectations and strategic objectives. Qualifications For The Role 12+ years of senior commercial leadership in industrial B2B environments, ideally in drives, motors, or related automation technologies Proven track record of profitable multi-country sales growth with direct P&L accountability - including both defending existing business and winning new market share Demonstrated experience developing markets and expanding customer bases, not just managing existing accounts Experience providing structured portfolio and pricing feedback to product or business line organizations - and influencing product strategy based on market intelligence Ability to identify and articulate product adaptation, certification, and infrastructure needs with commercial specificity and business case rigor Demonstrated commercial instinct for identifying acquisition targets or partnership opportunities that accelerate market access or capability Experience leading geographically distributed sales organizations end-to-end, including back-office execution functions Strong strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution capability and disciplined performance management across the full commercial cycle Fluency in English and other regional languages. Assets Familiarity with ABB Motion's portfolio (drives, motors, services) and its competitive landscape internationally, NEMA Motors is a plus Experience navigating complex matrix organizations across business lines, product management, and geographies Prior involvement in M&A processes, market entry studies, or footprint planning in an industrial context More About Us ABB’s NEMA Motors Division is a marketer, designer and manufacturer that offers Baldor-Reliance® industrial electric motors, primarily in North America. The Division focuses on quality, reliability and efficiency to provide a comprehensive offering of NEMA motors in the market across most industrial segments and applications. We value people from different backgrounds.
